author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie is offering a million-dollar reward for the return of her mom dead or alive. For the first time in a new video, the "TODAY" show co-host acknowledged that 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie may not have survived the brutal kidnapping. Savannah also acknowledged the tens of thousands of missing persons whose cases did not get the same attention as her mothers and is donating half a million dollars to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.
title: Savannah Guthrie Offers $1 Million For Return Of Mother Nancy Guthrie

author: Inside Edition
description: Many people showed up after a social media post called for an afternoon romp in the snow at New York City's Washington Square Park. NYPD responded to 911 calls of a "disorderly crowd." Suddenly, the throng started aiming their snowballs at the officers. During the storm, over 40 million people across eight states were under blizzard warnings.
title: Uproar After NYPD Cops Hit With Snowballs By Massive Crowd

author: Inside Edition
description: A large coyote chased a child at a California home. Mother Aida Svell tells Inside Edition's Jim Moret she heard a scream and saw what was happening in the driveway before she screamed. The family says they have seen coyotes in their woodsy neighborhood in Pasadena but they've never seen a coyote run up their driveway. Pasadena authorities have issued urgent warnings following a recent increase in aggressive coyote activity.
title: Coyote Chases 3-Year-Old Boy At California Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Children's book author Kouri Richins is accused of poisoning her husband's cocktail. New police bodycam footage has been released from the night Richins' husband Eric Richins was found unresponsive at the family home in Utah. A year later, Kouri appeared on a local TV station to promote her children's book about dealing with grief. Prosecutors say Kouri killed her husband to be with another man. Kouri's attorney insists her client is innocent and that Eric died of natural causes.
title: New Bodycam Video Played During Grief Author's Murder Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Coffee pods are great for a quick cup of joe, but every brew leaves behind the pod, made of plastic and/or metal, to just be discarded in the trash. An Australian designer saw a new use for the leftover pods. Lizzie Burscough says she's saved 40 thousand coffee pods from landfills by turning them into statement jewelry. It's just one way she's trying to find a new life for something that would otherwise be trashed. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Artist Turns Used Coffee Pods Into Earrings

author: Inside Edition
description: Nick Reiner spoke only once when he agreed to waive the right to a speedy preliminary hearing in California.
title: Nick Reiner Pleads Not Guilty In Murders Of His Parents #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: New York City was shut down Monday by a historic winter storm that dumped almost two feet of snow.
title: NYC Clears Snowy Streets With Help Of Citizen Shovelers #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A home was fully engulfed in flames with people still inside when the Sarasota Police department showed up to the scene. People who got out were frantically trying to get help to the people still inside. A person in the home was having trouble leaving because she couldn't walk very well. The officer who found her was trying to get her out when more officers showed up. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Rescue 2 People From House Fire In Florida
